control_profile: Controls off: unchanged weekly residual cross-sectional momentum targets with no volatility scaling, drawdown brake, position stop, time stop, or turnover throttle.
falsifier: Reject the control-harm hypothesis if removing the overlay fails to improve fold breadth and Sharpe without creating unacceptable drawdown, turnover, or cost sensitivity.
formation_horizon: one-hundred-twenty-six-day beta estimate and eighty-four-day residual momentum with a seven-day skip
hypothesis: Frequent stops and drawdown interventions suppress the weekly residual-momentum portfolio; the unchanged raw targets should preserve relative trends and reveal whether the weak folds are signal or overlay failures.
rebalance_horizon: weekly at the first UTC decision boundary
